name: Tokenory Register
source_reference: tokenory-register.origin.svg — previous Tokenory illustration, source of the numeral outlines and palette. New full-bleed composition.
brief: An edge-to-edge section of a three-drum mechanical counter. The orange shell and reels occupy the full tile. A seven-degree tilt is shared by the readout and the lips of the instrument.

semantic_review.basis: Original Tokenory artwork. Verify the new crop and the shared axes rather than matching the previous composition.

app_context.job_to_be_done: read accumulated tokens and cost estimates

style.style_notes: Macro view of an odometer. The visible silhouette is the machine itself.

icon_intent.metaphor: The units wheel advancing on a mechanical register.
icon_intent.small_size_readability: Three large numerals, a light units drum, two orange shell lips.

canvas.alignment: The housing lips and register rotate together 7° counterclockwise. The artwork extends beyond the canvas on all sides.

must_preserve: the visible register runs across both side edges

layers.shape_model: outlined 1, 2, 8 and the top of the following 9
must_preserve: lifted units digit and partially revealed 9

layers.shape_model: two continuous rails, cropped by the icon contour
layers.fill: mandarin enamel and cast inner surfaces
must_preserve: both lips use the exact axis of the register
